ExtensionProtocols.description: ExtensionProtocols is the external Collection protocol window.

current.description: Current is the newest version, the one a program built with this release's pkg/external names as its protocol.

versions.description: Versions are every version this build speaks, oldest first, each supported or deprecated with the release that removes it.

Protocol.description: Protocol is one protocol version this build speaks.

removed_in.description: RemovedIn names the release that stops speaking a deprecated version.

status.description: Status says whether it is supported or deprecated. Known values: supported, deprecated. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

description: VersionReport is what a binary says about itself: its version, its release's name, and the external Collection protocols it speaks, so a Collection author's CI, or an operator about to upgrade, reads which programs this build will load without running one. Printed by pleiades version --json and runner version --json. schema_version is the major version: it goes up only for a change an existing reader could misread, a field removed or renamed or given another type or meaning. Within a major version a newer producer may add fields, and new values to the open sets. So a reader ignores a field it does not know, treats a status or kind it does not know as not a pass, and refuses a major version it does not know.

codename.description: Codename is the release's name, absent for a development build.

extension_protocols.description: ExtensionProtocols are the external Collection protocol versions this build speaks.

program.description: Program is the binary that printed it: pleiades or runner. Known values: pleiades, runner. A newer producer may add others, and a reader treats one it does not know as not a pass.

schema_version.description: SchemaVersion is this document's major version.

version.description: Version is the build's version: a release, or 0.0.0-dev+<commit>.

title: Pleiades version
